description: Manage the server-level codex library of reusable, cross-Novel content (NPCs, characters, scenes, encounters, lore, factions, rooms, things, templates, voice profiles, adventures). Entries persist to `.holonovel-state/codex.json` outside every Novel and survive restarts; mutations are audited. Out-of-play and badge-free: requires the Editor or Game Master badge, a Player mid-adventure gets `[FORBIDDEN]`, and reads are not badge-filtered. When no Novel is active, the codex is the default store; `import` and `capture` require an active Novel. `set` needs `kind` + `name` (the id derives from them); merge=true shallow-merges content. Revert the most recent mutation with manage_history (action: undo). Use when: storing reusable content for later import, or enumerating/reading/deleting it. Do NOT use when: storing Novel-scoped content — use manage_lore (action: set) or manage_note (action: set).

action.description: set (create/update), list, get, capture (Novel artifact per kind), import (into active Novel), or delete.

content.description: Entry content (for set); when omitted on an existing entry, the stored content is preserved.

entity_id.description: Entity whose voice to capture (for capture, voice_profile kind).

id.description: Entry identifier or array of identifiers (for import/get/delete).

merge.description: For set: when true and the entry exists, shallow-merge the provided content into the stored content instead of replacing it.

source_id.description: Novel artifact key/name/entity id to capture (for capture). Defaults per kind.

update_source.description: When true, update the source Codex entry in place (for capture).

name: manage_codex

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Codex Library Management
